question: How many members in “Council of States” can be nominated by President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct option** is **12 members** as per **Article 80(1)(a)** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The President of India can nominate members to the **Council of States **in order to ensure representation of experts and knowledgeable individuals.
 
• The nominated members have the **same rights and privileges** as the elected members of the Council of States.
 
• The nominated members can serve for a term of **6 years** and can be re-nominated for another term.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Council of States, also known as** Rajya Sabha**, is the upper house of the** Indian Parliament.**
 
• Members of the Council of States are elected by the members of the** State Legislative Assemblies.**
 
• The President of India can nominate **12 members **to the Council of States who are experts in various fields like** literature, science, art, and social service.**
